invariants: Nonnegative safe-integer starting stock is valid, including zero; every reserved quantity is a positive safe integer.
Reservation keys are permanently bound to one exact SKU and quantity; retries cannot subtract stock again, even after a release.
Insufficient stock fails without creating a reservation or consuming an idempotency key.
Two independent SQLite processes competing to reserve the last unit cannot both succeed.
Release restores stock exactly once; repeated releases do not restore twice.
SKU, retry key, reservation IDs, and numeric inputs are validated with explicit error codes.
SQLite single-file transactional correctness under covered tests is not a guarantee of distributed inventory correctness, ledger reconciliation, or arbitrary contention.
